title: Robustness and Reasoning Fidelity of Large Language Models in Long-Context Code Question Answering

bias_targets.methodology: Randomizing and shuffling the order of multiple-choice answer options to test model sensitivity to option arrangement and ordering effects.

Conducting 'needle-in-a-haystack' experiments by injecting relevant and irrelevant code snippets at varying depths (Start, Middle, End) of the context window to evaluate position-dependent retrieval accuracy.

Comparing multiple-choice evaluation against open-ended question answering (without options) to determine if models rely on superficial lexical overlap between questions and options rather than genuine comprehension.
